title: Seal derived-output collection views against backing-store mutation
description:
Council multi-round audit found read-only-looking APIs that still exposed mutable backing collections through interface views. This work now covers GeneratedCreature.Geometry, CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.Bones, and CreatureRig.IndexedBones.

Scope: return actual read-only wrappers/snapshots, add regression coverage for cast-based mutation, preserve ordering and object identity, and keep runtime/editor ownership unchanged. Coordinate with TSK-0125 (GeneratedCreature), TSK-0132 (skinned adapter), and the indexed-rig contract.

Implemented in current branch: GeneratedCreature.Geometry now uses a cached ReadOnlyCollection; CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.Bones now uses a cached read-only view; CreatureRig.IndexedBones now uses a cached read-only view. Focused generated-output ownership coverage includes nested influence collections and GeneratedCreature.Geometry. Remaining gap: focused CreatureRig/renderer cast-mutation regression and Unity execution.

Validation gate: runtime build plus focused ownership tests; Unity execution required before closure.

comments.author: council-exhaustive-audit
comments.body: Implemented current-scope ownership hardening at HEAD lineage: GeneratedCreature.Geometry, CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.Bones, and CreatureRig.IndexedBones now expose cached read-only wrappers rather than backing collections. No Unity validation performed yet; task remains InProgress.
